def: An LLM-as-judge method in which the judge first generates evaluation steps with chain of thought, then fills in a score form, with the final score weighted by each score token’s probability.
practice: Available in eval libraries such as DeepEval for custom criteria; the 2023 paper reports a Spearman correlation of 0.514 with human ratings on summarization and warns that LLM judges may favor LLM-written text.
